name: smwmusic-shin-megami-tensei-ii-gym
title: Shin Megami Tensei II - Gym
description:
There‘s a different version of this track with a different instrument in SMT if... known as 'Important Meeting‘.
You can switch between the SMT 1 and SMT if… versions with:
set define to #define Version 0, to get the SMT 2 version
set define to #define Version 1, to get the SMT if... version
